Font assets are served locally. Newsreader Latin normal/italic (400–600) are unchanged WOFF2 assets from the existing ZuRecht Next font build. Geist Latin is the unchanged asset bundled with Next 16.3.3. The shared manifest records their SHA-256 hashes.

Upstream notices obtained 10 October 2026:

- https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/newsreader/OFL.txt
- https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/geist/OFL.txt

Both fonts retain their SIL Open Font License 1.1 and copyright notices in this directory. No browser request to a font CDN is required.
